notes.title: We are launching a new game this month!
notes.content:
Hello goodkid!

After creating [b]Rage in Peace[/b] and co-developing [b]What Comes After[/b] with Pikselnesia, now we are ready to announce that our new game, [b]Hello Goodboy[/b], which will be released on May 25th! We’re inviting you to join the excitement and experience the wholesome journey in this game!

[h1]Hello Goodboy![/h1]

Hello Goodboy is a cozy and wholesome narrative game about finding the purpose of your journey in the afterlife. You will play as Iko and have Coco the cute doggo as your company.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38877147/7990de78a79e6207b1153cdc894d1805f70ebd71.gif[/img]

In this game, you can meet various and unique characters, do nice things to others, enjoy delicious food, and pet the dog! You can do all of that while trying to unveil the mystery of your journey in this place to mend your forgotten past memories and life.

Watch the Hello Goodboy wholesome trailer here:
[previewyoutube=NsyCkqOlk0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Goodboy will be released on May 25th 2023 on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Epic, and GOG. Make sure to wishlist the game so you will not miss the date!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789090

Have a good day from Hello Goodboy!

=====

Get a wholesome update from us on Twitter!
https://twitter.com/rollinggloryjam

notes.title: Bug fixes update for Simplified Chinese
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First of all, thank you so much for playing What Comes After, your support means so much to us.

A few days ago, I was notified by our friend who helped localizing the game to Chinese (thanks 依然爱国足!) that the Chinese version has a bug that made you stuck during the scene with the old tree.
I just want to notify you that we have found and fixed the problem. Simply update your game to the latest version, and you should be able to play the game without much trouble now.

We're really sorry for the inconvenience, and we hope you have a pleasant journey with Vivi.

Thank you!

notes.title: New Languages, Trading Cards, Sales, and a new game announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38877147/4fe2ee97752d076830b474187d5f997ac1305172.png[/img]
Hello everyone!

Hope things are amazing in your days.

Today, I would like to announce that we have some interesting updates for the game!

[list]
[*] Starting today, the game is available in Spanish, Portuguese, French, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Indonesian!
[*] Trading cards are also available for you to collect as you play the game
[*] 30% discount!
[/list]
The team behind What Comes After (now we're calling ourselves After Hours Dev!) is working on a new game!
Right now, we're announcing it as Project Heartbreak, which you can wishlist in the link below. We're going to tell you more about the game in the coming months, but for now, do enjoy What Comes After and the teaser for our next project!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599780/Project_Heartbreak/

notes.title: New updates and bug fixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38877147/6712a5dd3d1de85413254a71464490b0ebb9b816.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

First of all, I would like to thank you for your support and positivity.

We just launched the game three days ago and you all have been very positive about it, even when some of you stumbled upon some problems that make the game literally unplayable. For that, we are very sorry and very thankful for your support in helping us finding out the root of the cause.

The good news is, we have found the solution to the problem and all you need to do is update the game and you should be able to play it just fine!

Some changes we made in the update:
[list]
[*] Fix the black screen problems for some users that use non-US Windows setting
[*] Update the German localization with a proper proofreading and editing
[*] New option that allows you to turn on/off the screen shake in the game
[*] Fix the problem where the ending song is controlled through the SFX slider instead of the BGM slider
[/list]

That's it for the latest update folks. Once again thank you so much for your support. And to close the announcement I'd like to give a shout out to the beautiful fan art made by one of our player here, do leave a like on the post!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2278764094
